title: 30-Minute Driving Tour: Explore Los Angeles in a Cybertruck
includes: Stop for pictures at Hollywood Sign
If additional passengers are added after booking, there is a $20/pers fee ( 4 guests max/vehicle) (not included)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Be among the first to experience the Tesla Cybertruck, one of the world's most innovative and sought-after vehicles. Cruise through the streets of Hollywood in futuristic style before heading into the scenic Hollywood Hills, where you'll enjoy breathtaking views and a photo stop at the iconic Hollywood Sign.

This 30-minute guided adventure begins near the Hollywood Walk of Fame and includes a thrilling ride with fast-lane access, giving you more time to enjoy the experience. Whether you choose to drive or ride as a passenger, you'll have the opportunity to capture unforgettable photos and experience Los Angeles from behind the wheel—or seat—of one of the world's most talked-about vehicles.

Perfect for car enthusiasts, first-time visitors, and anyone looking for a one-of-a-kind Hollywood adventure, this is your chance to experience the future while exploring one of LA's most famous neighborhoods.
